sources.abstract: The invention discloses a digital human video generation method and device, equipment, a storage medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: calculating a business characteristic item based on a pre-generated business attribute feature vector, and pre-obtained user behavior data and commodity information; calculating a digital human video optimization objective function based on the service characteristic item, the service attribute characteristic vector and a pre-generated service attribute weight vector; and performing quantum annealing algorithm optimization based on the digital human video optimization objective function to obtain an optimal feature vector of the digital human video content, generating the digital human video content based on the optimal feature vector of the digital human video content, and obtaining the digital human video content based on the combination of the business characteristic item calculation and the optimization objective function and the efficient optimization of the quantum annealing algorithm. Therefore, highly-personalized digital human video content generation is realized, the matching degree between the video content and user preference and commodity information is remarkably improved, and the generation efficiency is improved at the same time.

sources.title: Existing building regeneration optimization design method based on quantum annealing algorithm [CN122490682A]
sources.abstract: The present invention discloses an existing building regeneration optimization design method based on a quantum annealing algorithm. The method comprises: S1, establishing an existing building digital model; s2, establishing a building multi-stage regeneration unit discrete state model; s3, establishing a building regeneration multi-index evaluation model; s4, establishing a building regeneration comprehensive cost function; s5, building a building regeneration unit coupling relation model; s6, establishing a building regeneration quantum annealing optimization model; and S7, solving the building regeneration quantum annealing optimization model by using a quantum annealing algorithm to output a global optimal building regeneration scheme. According to the method, a discrete regeneration state model of each unit of a building is established, a building regeneration energy evaluation model of each factor is constructed, and a quantum annealing algorithm is utilized to perform global search on a building regeneration state space, so that collaborative optimization of regeneration strategies of the existing building is realized, and an existing building regeneration optimization design scheme is generated. And the overall performance and the intelligent optimization efficiency of the building update design are improved.

sources.title: Intelligent start-stop and water flow intensity self-adaptive control method for solar fountain [CN122488494A]
authors: YANGZHOU CITY ZHONGHUAN HI TECH PLASTIC CO LTD
sources.organization: YANGZHOU CITY ZHONGHUAN HI TECH PLASTIC CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic control of solar fountains, in particular to an intelligent start-stop and water flow intensity adaptive control method of a solar fountain, which comprises the following steps: S1, collecting photovoltaic output power, illumination intensity and water level parameters through a sensor, and obtaining a quantum state mapping rule based on a preset quantum state mapping rule; encoding the quantum feature vector into a normalized quantum feature vector; and S2, on the basis of a quantum debugging technology, constructing and updating a quantum system model in which the fountain load is matched with the photovoltaic power in real time, and representing and pre-judging the running state of the system. According to the invention, through quantum coding, quantum modeling and quantum optimization technologies, accurate adaptation of multi-source parameters of the photovoltaic-fountain system and optimal matching of power-load are realized, precision and decision-making efficiency of intelligent start-stop and water flow intensity control are greatly improved, and operation fluctuation caused by uncertainty of photovoltaic power supply is effectively reduced.

sources.title: Soil sampling multi-objective optimization method based on quantum annealing algorithm [CN122452836A]
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a soil sampling multi-objective optimization method based on a quantum annealing algorithm, and the method achieves the efficient simplification of an original sampling point set through the construction of a comprehensive multi-objective evaluation function on the premise of maintaining the pollution risk characteristics to the greatest extent. According to the method, quantum computing characteristics such as quantum tunneling, polymorphic superposition and quantum interference are creatively fused, and four key indexes including spatial distribution similarity, three-dimensional volume overlapping degree, pollution risk consistency and heavy metal migration mode consistency are comprehensively considered. The cost is remarkably reduced while the sampling precision is guaranteed, and an efficient and economical integrated solution is provided for three-dimensional visualization of pollutants.

sources.title: Quantum fuzzy voltage regulation method and system for rail transit vehicle-mounted frequency converter [CN122456538A]
sources.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of rail transit electrical control, in particular to a quantum fuzzy voltage regulation method and system for a rail transit vehicle-mounted frequency converter, and the method comprises the steps: collecting four-dimensional operation data, such as load current and voltage, and carrying out the Kalman filtering and EMC compensation preprocessing; mapping and coding the four-dimensional variable quantum bits, and constructing a quantum superposition state containing disturbance compensation; a membership function is optimized based on quantum probability distribution, and an adjustment instruction is generated through quantum annealing algorithm iterative reasoning; and the IGBT is driven to execute voltage regulation and form closed-loop feedback control. The system is realized based on an FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) and comprises a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a quantum fuzzy calculation module and the like. According to the invention, the problems of poor dynamic load adaptation, weak interference resistance and lack of multi-parameter collaboration of the existing frequency converter can be solved, and the comprehensive improvement of the voltage regulation response speed and precision of the vehicle-mounted frequency converter and the system collaboration is realized.

sources.title: SCHEDULING METHOD FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE COMPUTING [WO2026154358A1]
sources.abstract: Scheduling method for high performance computers in which a network of servers (3) are connected to each other via connections to form respective nodes n generally having mutually different hardware structures, the method comprising the steps of : submitting ( 100 ) a JOB specifying the required computational resources, i. e. the necessary nodes n and for each node n required the desired hardware resources and the time of access to the nodes; defining the number of SUBJOBs as the number of required nodes forming a submitted JOB; defining a binary variable (block 120 ) x s,n ϵ { 0. 1 } where s indicates the subjob to be allocated and n indicates the computation node; defining a cost function H comprising the sum of several addends, in which each addend is given by the multiplication of a coefficient λ I or weight and of a term H i which is in turn a function of the binary variable x s,n . Each term H i corresponds to an objective function to be optimised or to a constraint; operating the search for the global minimum of the cost function H by quantum annealing; the binary variables x s,n of the global minimum of the cost function H identify the computation nodes n on which the subjobs s x s, n can be allocated most efficiently; assigning the identified computation nodes (block 150 ) to the JOB.

sources.title: Quantum optimization solution method and system, Isin machine, electronic equipment and readable medium [CN122433936A]
authors: BEIJING BOSE QUANTUM TECH CO LTD
sources.organization: BEIJING BOSE QUANTUM TECH CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention relates to a quantum optimization solution method and system, an Isin machine, electronic equipment and a readable medium, the quantum optimization solution method is used for performing iterative optimization solution on a quantum spin array, and the quantum optimization solution method comprises the following steps: in each iteration, performing iterative optimization solution on the quantum spin array; weak measurement with adjustable coupling strength is carried out on quantum spin units in the quantum spin array, so that partial state information of the quantum spin units is obtained; based on the partial state information, unitary feedback operation is applied to the quantum spin unit to update the quantum state of the quantum spin unit; in the process of performing iterative optimization solution on the quantum spin array, the coupling strength of weak measurement is adaptively adjusted according to the system energy change rate of the quantum spin array. According to the method, strong projection measurement is replaced by weak measurement with adjustable coupling strength, so that the quantum coherence and tunneling effect can be kept while the state information is obtained, and the solving performance of the combination optimization problem is improved.

sources.title: SHAP value calculation method of machine learning model and related device [CN122433932A]
sources.abstract: The invention discloses an SHAP value calculation method of a machine learning model and a related device, and relates to the technical field of interpretable machine learning, and the method comprises the steps: firstly, determining a mapping relation between each feature subset corresponding to the machine learning model and a model prediction effect as a target function set; and a secondary unconstrained binary optimization matrix is adopted to convert a feature subset selection problem into a combinatorial optimization problem. Then, a high-contribution feature subset of the machine learning model is searched in parallel in a quantum state space by adopting a quantum optimization algorithm, the search space is in a polynomial level, and the calculation complexity of the SHAP value is greatly reduced; monte Carlo sampling is carried out based on the high-contribution feature subset, the effective sampling proportion of Monte Carlo sampling is improved, and the calculation precision of the SHAP value is further improved. And finally, determining a core feature based on the SHAP value of each feature, and generating key decision information corresponding to a service scene to which the machine learning model belongs according to the core feature.

sources.title: Discrete topological optimization method combining Isin Hamiltonian mapping model and quantum annealing mechanism [CN122413789A]
sources.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering structure optimization and intelligent computing, in particular to a discrete topological optimization method combining an Isin Hamiltonian quantity mapping model and a quantum annealing mechanism. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a discrete topological optimization mathematical model taking structural rigidity maximization and material lightweight as double targets; further according to an Isin model theory, mapping a material density variable into a quantum spin variable, and thus forming a solvable Isin Hamiltonian quantity structure energy function; and then, under a quantum-classical hybrid framework, realizing global optimization search by using quantum annealing evolution, and carrying out local refinement through a classical gradient algorithm to obtain discrete topological distribution of gray-scale-free units. An annealing parameter and a step length coefficient are set, and a Lyapunov stability theory is adopted to deduce an iteration convergence condition, so that the stability of the algorithm is ensured. Compared with an existing continuous approximation method and a traditional intelligent algorithm, the method has the advantages that the global convergence speed is high, the calculation precision is high, gray units can be effectively eliminated, the structural rigidity is improved by about 25%, the calculation time is shortened by about 60% and the like, and the method is suitable for topological optimization design of complex engineering structures such as mechanical manufacturing, aerospace and additive manufacturing.

sources.title: Personalized rehabilitation management method based on AI [CN122417273A]
authors: SHENZHEN YIQI SHIGUANG TECH CO LTD
sources.organization: SHENZHEN YIQI SHIGUANG TECH CO LTD
sources.abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to an AI-based personalized rehabilitation management method. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring gene, physiology, cognition, environment and other multi-source heterogeneous data of a patient; then encoding the data to a quantum computing processing unit, and performing cross-modal depth analysis and key feature extraction by using quantum parallelism; on the basis, a personalized health state model and a rehabilitation effect prediction model are constructed; then, determining a current state vector of the patient based on the health state model, inputting the current state vector and the candidate intervention measure set into a prediction model, and searching through a quantum optimization algorithm to generate a personalized comprehensive rehabilitation scheme which comprises at least two collaborative measures and has specific parameters and targets; in the scheme execution process, patient response data are continuously collected, real-time simulation and trajectory comparison are conducted through the prediction model, and adjustment and re-optimization of the scheme are dynamically triggered according to deviation. According to the invention, accurate, dynamic and efficient personalized rehabilitation management of the Alzheimer's disease patient is realized.

sources.title: Multi-rotor attitude control method combining reinforcement learning with multi-scale quantum optimization [CN122387143A]
authors: SICHUAN YUNYI LOW ALTITUDE ECONOMIC CO LTD
sources.organization: SICHUAN RAILWAY VOCATIONAL COLLEGE, SICHUAN YUNYI LOW ALTITUDE ECONOMIC CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-rotor attitude control method combining reinforcement learning with multi-scale quantum optimization, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle flight control. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a multi-rotor kinetic model framework, collecting open-loop input and output test data to construct an agent model, and completing kinetic model parameter identification through iterative optimization of a multi-scale quantum optimization algorithm; collecting manual control flight data to initialize a reinforcement learning state action mapping relation, designing an action search direction screening mechanism, and adopting a quadratic reward function to complete iterative training of a reinforcement learning strategy; the trained strategy is transplanted to a flight controller, online exploration is carried out near a horizontal hovering balance point, the attitude angle range is gradually expanded, and self-learning and correction of the control strategy are achieved. The method does not need to depend on accurate model parameters of a controlled object, improves the efficiency and precision of parameter identification, accelerates the convergence speed of a reinforcement learning strategy, and enhances the adaptability and robustness of multi-rotor attitude control.

sources.abstract: The invention discloses a secret key generation method and device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the column width iteration adjustment of a binary multiplication table constructed based on a target integer, and determining an optimal column dividing strategy with the minimum number of solved variables as a target; according to the optimal column dividing strategy, constructing a QUBO model decomposed by the target integer; carrying out simulation calculation on the QUBO model, and constructing a solution resource pool; wherein the solution resource pool comprises a plurality of solution instances; carrying out iterative optimization on the solution instances in the solution resource pool by adopting a quantum annealing calculation mechanism based on a subQUBO model, and determining an optimal solution; generating an RSA secret key according to the prime number factor corresponding to the optimal solution; according to the method, the calculation complexity of the quantum annealing solving process is effectively reduced, and efficient and accurate RSA secret key generation and recovery are realized.

draft.summary: Research activity on quantum annealing is rising: papers grew 38.8% from 2024 to 2025, and the year-to-date count is up 88.4% on the same period of 2025 [S1-S10]. The strongest technical result is a narrow scaling advantage on a constructed spin-glass family, and it comes from one group and has not been replicated [S1, C1]. Other benchmarks are mixed or favour classical methods [S2, R2, R3, C2]. Hardware limits remain: chain-embedding errors, open-system noise, shrinking energy gaps, and error correction shown only in limited settings [R1, R4, R5, R6]. Commercial evidence rests almost entirely on D-Wave, a micro-cap with USD 25M revenue, R&D above 200% of revenue, and one customer test described in its filing [M1, M5, K1]. Patent filings jumped in 2025 but are cooling this year, and recent years are undercounted because of publication delay [P1-P5]. D-Wave's share price is in a deep, volatile drawdown [T1, T2]. The main uncertainty is whether any advantage extends beyond contrived problems to useful scale without help from classical preprocessing [R7, C6].
draft.plain_summary: Quantum annealing is a special kind of quantum computer built to find good answers to scheduling and routing-style puzzles. Research interest is clearly growing, but the proof that it beats ordinary computers is so far limited to narrow, specially built test problems. The main thing that could stop it is that noise and hardware limits may stop it from ever beating conventional methods on real business problems.
